szoveg_eredeti:
2026 was the year everything shifted in how we build software.
But a year of rapid change also brings hard questions:

- How do we architect systems that leverage AI without becoming dependent on it?
- What did we learn about testing, reliability, and maintainability when iteration cycles compress?
- How do we hire and structure engineering teams when the nature of the work itself is changing?

We’re still figuring it out. And we want to figure it out together.

This Thursday, October 29, we’re joining Raycast and Linear in Paris for The New Standard: a conversation between engineers about the architectural decisions that worked, the ones that didn’t, and what we’re building toward in 2027.

On stage:
 Thomas Paul Mann , CEO and Co-founder, Raycast 
 Tuomas Artman , CTO and Co-founder, Linear 
 Théo Carrive , VP Engineering, Mistral
Moderated by Tanguy Le Stradic , CPO, Evy 

📍Galerie Au Roi, 73-75 Rue de la Fontaine au Roi, Paris.
Doors open at 6pm, the conversation starts at 6:30pm sharp.
